description: Use when the user wants to quickly understand a conversation, article, paper, tutorial, product brief, long thread, or messy discussion: what is going on, who said what, topics, positions, agreements/disagreements, or a clearer structural explanation. Always delivers a structured text version plus a lightweight self-contained HTML infographic.
